channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block D1
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Block D1 (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block D1: Block D1's record and map shape now say: the base building maximum is 100 ft (the 80 ft and 305 ft labels are horizontal dimensions, not a minimum height); the land-use plan and Section 6.5.2 quoted are in the Design Controls dated April 24, 2018, not the 2012 proposal; 'unbuilt and surface parking' is attributed to the Port's June 2026 update; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the Jan 30, 2018, Oct 10, 2023, March 11, 2025 and June 9, 2026 Port Commission actions cite the minutes and the quoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block D1: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range.
item.description: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, Jan 30 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block D1: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34, authorizing up to $10 million in Port Capital as pre-development funding for Phase 2 (design/engineering for Phase 2 infrastructure and vertical buildings), intended to avoid a 12-18 month delay to construction readiness. Staff's schedule contemplates horizontal infrastructure and vertical building construction beginning as early as Summer/Fall 2027, but the memo's own Table 1 gives illustrative repayment scenarios for a 2027, 2028 or 2029 vertical construction start, contingent on the Developer securing anchor tenants -- not a committed date for this or any other Phase 2 block. (Jun 9, 2026)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block D1: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025)

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Block D1: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10.
